capabilities: Show a monthly or vertical-scroll calendar grid with daily, weekly and event dot indicators
Create and open daily and weekly notes from templates
Track tasks with badges, heatmaps and date or tag grouping, completing them from the list
Display dashboards of task summaries and customizable file-creation heatmap widgets
Manage a scratchpad, recent and pinned notes, and vault assets in tab panels
disambiguation: Not just a calendar view; it also bundles a task manager, a dashboard with charts and heatmaps, a scratchpad, and asset tracking.
extras: README includes developer release/versioning instructions unrelated to usage. External .ics calendar requests are disabled by default and the plugin states it never connects directly to Todoist, only via the Todoist Sync plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, and users planning their year in 13 periods of 4 weeks have no calendar that supports that structure alongside their notes and tasks.

relations.evidence: Calendar Period Week Notes can integrate with Todoist through the third-party Todoist Sync community plugin
Use Todoist as the task source, or combine Todoist with Obsidian Tasks.

summary: Calendar plugin with monthly and vertical-scroll grids, a 13-period/4-week year system, and tabbed panels for scratchpad, tasks, notes, assets and dashboards.
